## What's new

**🆕 "What's new" after every update** ([#9](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/9))
- From the next update on, the first time Discord starts after Friends in Voice updates, a window shows what changed, including any versions you skipped. It shows once per Discord.
- Turn it off with **Show what's new** in the plugin settings.

**🔗 GitHub link**
- A **GitHub** link at the bottom of the Friends in Voice page opens the project page, next to **Check for updates**.

Everything is in the BetterDiscord version too.

## Update

Vencord: click the new-version notification on Windows or macOS, or download `FriendsInVoice-v1.15.0.zip` and run `install.bat` on Windows or `install.command` / `bash install.sh` on macOS.

BetterDiscord: replace your plugin file with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release.

## Verification

Vencord TypeScript check and lint passed, plus the plugin tests and all 24 BetterDiscord port tests.
